Subject: Pool topology & autoscale: architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Hi Marcus / Alice,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. OliveTech's throughput profile looks like a great fit for a dedicated pool but we should walk through the topology and autoscale fallback behavior in one session so both infra and product teams are aligned before we produce the formal capacity plan.

Proposed scope (60–75 minutes):
- Quick recap of OliveTech workload characteristics (10 min)
- Pool topology options (isolation layers, slab vs. shared pools) (20 min)
- Autoscale guardrails and warm-up strategies (15 min)
- Failure/fallback scenarios and SLA trade-offs (15 min)
- Action items / mutual action plan (5–10 min)

Would next Wednesday or Thursday work for you? My available windows (PDT):
- Wed 2027-05-05: 09:30–12:00 or 14:00–16:30
- Thu 2027-05-06: 10:00–13:00

I've attached an agenda draft and a rough capacity estimate spreadsheet so you can scan ahead; happy to adjust the agenda if you'd prefer more focus on isolation/topology or on autoscale policies.

Attachments: agenda-draft.pdf (PDF), capacity-estimates.xlsx (XLSX), pool-topology-sketch.png (PNG)

Thanks —
Logan Wright
